data.name: Veil Breach: Raven County
data.detailed_description:
Raven County has gone dark. The VPA sent someone to figure out why. Not everyone heading in was sent by the VPA. Survive relentless waves of anomalies, build your loadout on the fly, and last as long as you can in a county that stopped making sense three days ago.

SURVIVE THE BREACH

Veil Breach: Raven County is a third-person 3D horde survival bullet heaven. Keep moving, collect XP, level up mid-run, and choose from a randomized selection of weapon upgrades as the waves grow heavier and faster. Take on quests scattered throughout each location, uncover what the VPA is not telling you, and decide when to go looking for a boss fight. Runs last under 30 minutes. Each one plays out differently.

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT MID-RUN

Passive weapons fire on their own. Active abilities are yours to control. The difference between a good run and a great one usually comes down to how well you use both.

Every level-up pulls from a randomized pool of upgrades spread across five rarity tiers, Common through Legendary. Stack bonuses on your existing weapons, crack open chests to unlock new ones, and build combinations that snowball hard before the final waves hit.

KEEP MOVING OR DIE

Standing still is not a strategy. Raven County is full of things that want you dead and the map itself is not on your side. Dodge booby traps, navigate environmental hazards, and use speed boosts and launch pads to stay one step ahead of the horde. Momentum is not just a playstyle, it is your best survival tool.

CHOOSE YOUR SURVIVOR

A VPA field agent. A couple of Raven County locals who are having the worst week of their lives. A chicken. And many more, each with their own story and their own reason for still being standing.

Every survivor comes with a different starting weapon. Pick one and see how far the run goes.

TWO LOCATIONS. ONE COUNTY.

Soma Castle

The knights of Soma Castle stood guard for centuries. Three days ago they started moving on their own. The VPA has logged the breach signatures coming from inside. They have not shared what the signatures matched.

Raven City

The city proper fell fast. Streets that had names now have none. Something is using the infrastructure and the Agency very much wants to know what before it figures out the rest of the county.

More of Raven County is out there. How much gets uncovered depends on how long you survive.

KEY FEATURES

  • Third-person 3D horde survival Bullet Heaven

  • Passive auto-fire weapons alongside player-controlled active abilities

  • Randomized upgrade system across five rarity tiers, Common to Legendary

  • Growing roster of survivors each with a unique starting weapon

  • Two hand-crafted maps with escalating wave difficulty

  • Quests scattered throughout each location

  • Optional boss encounters for those looking for a bigger fight

  • Environmental hazards, booby traps and speed boosts that reward aggressive movement

  • Collectibles including XP, gold, health packs and tactical consumables

  • Low-poly PSX visual style

  • Runs under 30 minutes, built for one more try

  • Full gamepad support and Steam Deck compatible

data.short_description: A fast-paced 3D paranormal horde survival roguelite. Choose your field operative, survive wave after wave of escalating anomalies, build a devastating mid-run loadout from randomized upgrades and pray ten minutes is long enough.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: 720p–1080p, Low settings, SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, Medium/High settings, SSD recommended

content_descriptors.notes: Veil Breach: Raven County contains stylized fantasy violence. Players fight waves of supernatural enemies using weapons and abilities in a low-poly, cartoon aesthetic. Enemies are defeated and removed from the screen with no blood, gore, or realistic injury depictions. The game features a dark paranormal setting that may be unsettling for younger players.
